name: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile
tagline: Dimpled Drainage Sheet and Waterproof protection layer
summary: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile is a drainage and protection sheet produced from high density polyethylene (HDPE) with dimples 8 mm deep and a filtration layer of geotextile (PP) bonded on the top.
metaDescription: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile is an HDPE drainage and protection sheet with 8 mm dimples and a bonded geotextile filtration layer for vertical drainage.
attributes: Can be installed on damp and even wet substrates
Resistant to all natural aggressive mediums in ground water and soil
Suitable for contact with soft water (aggressive to concrete)
SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile forms a drainage channel in the space between the structural elements and the back filling/soil/substrate to allow water to be drained away.
usage: As a drainage and protection sheet for preformed sheet membrane waterproofing systems, waterproofing mortars and coatings, and Sika® White Box concept for waterproofing basements.
advantages: Can be installed on damp and even wet substrates
Resistant to all natural aggressive mediums in ground water and soil
Suitable for contact with soft water (aggressive to concrete)

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: Geotextiles and geotextile-related products - Characteristics required for use in drainage systems' according to EN 13252, Declaration of Performance Nr.78023926 certified by notified factory production control certification body 1213 and provided with the CE marking.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Shelf life 5 years from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Rolls must be stored in their original packaging and in cool and dry conditions. They must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc.

items.label: Tensile strength
items.text: Tensile strength 10 (-2) kN/m (machine and cross direction) (EN 10319)

items.label: Drain flow capacity
items.text:
Horizontal application at 20 kPa (S/R, i= 0.04) | 0.30 l/(m·s) ± 20 %
Vertical application at 20 kPa (S/R, i= 1) | 1.9 l/(m·s) ± 20 %

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: Clean, sound and dry, homogeneous, free from oils and grease, dust and loose or friable particles.
